import numpy as np
from scipy import stats
from sklearn.feature_selection import mutual_info_classif

MAX_DRIVERS = 5

def design(feats):
    # Filter to significant features based on Welch's t-test
    p_values = stats.ttest_ind(feats.x[feats.y==1, :], feats.x[feats.y==0, :], equal_var=False)[1]
    sig_features = [i for i, p in enumerate(p_values) if p < 0.05]
    
    # Remove near-duplicates (correlated with |r| >= 0.6)
    correlated_pairs = [
        ('RWU10', 'GISL4B'), ('RWU10', 'HQE19L'), ('GISL4B', 'YVM19P'), ('GISL4B', 'WJT16'),
        ('QITT2', 'HQE19L'), ('HVW4', 'HAWA3P'), ('YVM19P', 'YGBY15'), ('AGXR17A', 'GPPB14B'),
        ('GISL4B', 'HQE19L'), ('RWU10', 'WJT16'), ('RWU10', 'YVM19P'), ('RWU10', 'QITT2'),
        ('CYB9', 'HQE19L'), ('YVM19P', 'WJT16'), ('RWU10', 'CYB9'), ('GPPB14B', 'TEAB1'),
        ('GISL4B', 'CYB9'), ('GISL4B', 'ULBP2A'), ('GISL4B', 'IMAY4P'), ('CYB9', 'WJT16')
    ]
    
    # Keep one feature from each correlated pair (prefer higher t-stat)
    kept_features = set()
    for fid1, fid2 in correlated_pairs:
        if fid1 in feats.ids and fid2 in feats.ids:
            idx1, idx2 = feats.column(fid1), feats.column(fid2)
            t1, t2 = abs(stats.ttest_ind(feats.x[feats.y==1, idx1], feats.x[feats.y==0, idx1], equal_var=False)[0]), \
                     abs(stats.ttest_ind(feats.x[feats.y==1, idx2], feats.x[feats.y==0, idx2], equal_var=False)[0])
            kept_features.add(fid1 if t1 > t2 else fid2)
    
    # Add non-correlated significant features
    for i in sig_features:
        fid = feats.ids[i]
        if not any(fid in pair for pair in correlated_pairs):
            kept_features.add(fid)
    
    # Use only kept features
    kept_indices = [feats.column(fid) for fid in kept_features if fid in feats.ids]
    X_sub = feats.x[:, kept_indices]
    
    # Compute mutual information to rank features
    mi_scores = mutual_info_classif(X_sub, feats.y)
    sorted_indices = np.argsort(mi_scores)[::-1][:MAX_DRIVERS]
    drivers = tuple([feats.ids[i] for i in sorted_indices if feats.ids[i] in kept_features])
    
    # Build products from top features
    products = []
    for i in range(min(2, len(drivers))):
        for j in range(i+1, min(3, len(drivers))):
            products.append((drivers[i], drivers[j]))
    
    # Simple weighted score using top features
    loadings = {}
    for i, fid in enumerate(drivers):
        idx = feats.column(fid)
        t_stat, _ = stats.ttest_ind(feats.x[feats.y==1, idx], feats.x[feats.y==0, idx], equal_var=False)
        loadings[fid] = abs(t_stat)
    
    # Ensure we don't exceed 12 total terms
    total_terms = len(drivers) + len(products) + len(loadings)
    if total_terms > 12:
        # Reduce products to maintain limit
        products = products[:max(0, 12 - len(drivers) - len(loadings))]
    
    return Design(
        drivers=drivers,
        columns=kept_features,
        products=tuple(products),
        loadings=loadings
    )
